program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # diff-pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # diff-pair L
    "Ltail": (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # bias / tail / sink L (mirror family)
    "Lld":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # stage-1 PMOS mirror load L
    "L7":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # second-stage PMOS L
    "itail": (36e-6, 30e-6, 60e-6),
    "i7":    (350e-6, 200e-6, 420e-6),
    "cc":    (3e-12, 2e-12, 4.5e-12),
    "kz":    (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),        # Rz = kz/gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    itl, i7, cc = p["itail"], p["i7"], p["cc"]
    gmid_b = 11.0
    # nfet bias family (same gm/Id and L): diode, tail, second-stage sink
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Ltail"], iref, vds=0.65)
    mt = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Ltail"], itl, vds=0.22)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_b, p["Ltail"], i7, vds=0.9)
    # differential pair (source near 0.22 V, so include body effect)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], itl / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.22)
    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", 10.0, p["Lld"], itl / 2, vds=0.8)
    # second-stage PMOS common source
    m7 = lut.size("p", 10.0, p["L7"], i7, vds=0.9)
    rz = p["kz"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", cc)

    # analytic predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    a0 = a1 * a2
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    c2 = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    wp2 = m7.gm * cc / (cc * c2 + c1 * (c2 + cc))
    wp3 = m3.gm / (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd)
    wu = 2 * PI * ugbw
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / wp2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / wp3))
    denom = cc * (1.0 / m7.gm - rz)
    if abs(denom) > 1e-30:
        wz = 1.0 / denom          # negative means an LHP zero, which adds phase
        if wz > 0:
            pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(wu / wz))
        else:
            pm += math.degrees(math.atan(wu / abs(wz)))
    wp4 = 1.0 / (rz * c1)
    pm -= math.degrees(math.atan(wu / wp4))
    slew = min(itl / cc, i7 / (cl + cc))
    power = vdd * (iref + itl + i7)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1
    return n, {"gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "power": power, "swing": swing}
